text:
```yaml
name: Skill Check

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # daily

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '7.x'

      - name: Restore .NET tools
        run: dotnet tool restore

      - name: Restore dependencies
        run: dotnet restore

      - name: Build solution
        run: dotnet build --no-restore

      - name: Run Skill Validator with MetricsCollector
        run: dotnet run --project src/SkillValidator/SkillValidator.csproj --collect-metrics
        # Adjust the command if the project path or flags differ

      - name: Generate token usage data
        shell: pwsh
        run: ./scripts/generate-token-data.ps1

      - name: Generate benchmark data
        shell: pwsh
        run: ./scripts/generate-benchmark-data.ps1

      - name: Upload token usage artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: token-usage
          path: data/token-usage.json

      - name: Upload benchmark artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: benchmark-data
          path: data/benchmark-data.json
```
